tagline: Offline Torah Notes & Hebrew Handwriting OCR Studio
taglineHebrew: סטודיו אופליין לזיהוי ועריכת כתב יד תורני ומחברות שיעורים
releaseTitle: v1.3.6 — Smart Close Safeguard, Multi-Page PDF Import, Click-to-Line Sync, Session Recovery & Batch Learning
description: Ohr HaKsav (אור הכתב) v1.3.6 delivers a comprehensive upgrade featuring smart exit safeguards, multi-page PDF document import, interactive click-to-line side-by-side synchronization, whole-notebook batch learning, sidebar page status badges, session auto-recovery, and background model pre-warming.
features: Smart Close & Exit Safeguard (closeEvent): Automatically intercepts closing the app (X button, Alt+F4, or File > Exit). If any attached pages have proofreading corrections that have not yet been learned into your memory profile, a friendly prompt offers [Save, Learn & Exit], [Exit Without Saving], or [Cancel], guaranteeing handwriting corrections are never lost.

Multi-Page PDF Import: Drop or attach multi-page PDF documents (such as scans from office copiers or phone scanner apps); Ohr HaKsav automatically renders each page to high-resolution 200 DPI images and queues them in your notebook.

Interactive Click-to-Line Synchronization: Click any line of handwritten text on the document viewer to jump the editor cursor directly to that line; as you proofread in the editor, the viewer automatically highlights and centers the corresponding handwritten line in warm gold.

Whole-Notebook Batch Learning: 'Save & Learn Mistakes' (Ctrl+L) now learns corrections across all modified pages in your session simultaneously with a single click, summarizing all newly learned words and modified page numbers.

Visual 'Pending Edits' Toolbar Indicator: The 'Save & Learn Mistakes' toolbar button dynamically highlights in amber and displays pending page counters (e.g. '💾 Save & Learn (2 Pages)*') the moment you make corrections in the editor, providing immediate visual awareness.

Automatic Learning on Document Export: Exporting your notes to Microsoft Word (.docx) or Plain Text (.txt) now automatically extracts and commits all pending handwriting corrections to your active profile, guaranteeing that exported documents and memory banks stay in sync.
Visual Page Status Badges in Sidebar: Color-coded status icons on every thumbnail in the left list (⚪ Ready to Scan, 🟠 Unsaved Edits Pending, 🟢 Scanned & Synced).

Session Auto-Recovery (Draft Protection): Automatically preserves your active session state to disk, offering to restore all attached pages, OCR transcriptions, and proofreading text if the workstation restarts.
Background Neural Vision Model Pre-Warming: Loads PyTorch Mishkefet neural OCR weights asynchronously in a background thread right after startup so the very first page scan initiates with zero delay.

Roaming Network Database Support: Supports configuring a shared network directory (e.g. \\newltcserver\Profiles) in settings or via OHR_HAKSAV_DATA_DIR, allowing handwriting profiles to roam across domain workstations.
Automated Test Suite & GitHub Actions CI: Complete unit test coverage for i18n parity, version consistency, diff learning, and PDF rendering running on automated CI.
